0022600097.text: Neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet, and the Raptors travel to Washington with Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles injury requiring surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot) unavailable. The teams have not met this season, but Toronto won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 134-125 road win in Washington on February 28, 2026. The Wizards will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip).
